name: Founder launch: the money, the product making beautiful work, the enemy, the offer
suits: a launch or funding announcement told by the founder
a product that MAKES things (decks, emails, posts, pages): show the work being made
AI agents that do the work, shown as teammates in the file
a giveaway or offer to close (comment to get one, sign up free)

spine.note: The founder to camera, the news in the first sentence ('We just raised $7.5M from ...'). The number rolls up big over them (a number-ticker or stamp across the lower half) while they say it; a backer's logo cuts in full-frame on its name for one beat (logo on white); then the founder steps to the right half and a piece of the product's work is edited live on the left (the asset-wall's first card, or a mockup being changed).
'All it takes is one prompt': the product's prompt box ALONE on a soft ground, the prompt typing in, a cursor clicking Create. No window chrome.

Back on the founder naming what it makes ('slide decks, marketing assets, animations and more'), finished work floating in the side columns around them: asset-wall layout 'orbit' (ground none, kinds named in the line), clear of the face.

'Let's say you built X, but it needs a lot of work': the drab before-version in the editor, tilted back in 3D on a light grid (pose rotate_x ~20, arriving flat), then the ask typed into the prompt ('make this look better and on brand').

THE SIGNATURE BEAT. A brand-gradient flash, then the product's agents as named cursors (agent-cursor: one colour each, 'Brand Agent', 'Research Agent', 'Design Agent') working as the voice names each one. The piece BUILDS in the editor (quotient-email-editor with sample or the real brand: blocks arrive, headline types, button pops) over a colourful asset-wall ground (layout wall, speed ~0.4), each cursor flying to the block its agent just made (targets 'email.logo', 'email.hero', 'email.headline', 'email.button', with a click). Name the agents in the order they work.

'Here's what makes it different': the real editor with its layers panel; a cursor selects a layer and changes it (colour, text), the change landing on the piece. Say the comparison the audience knows ('fully editable, just like Canva or Figma').
'Now turn it into 50 personalised versions': the same piece made for many brands landing in a wave (asset-wall layout 'grid' with a headline, kinds [the piece's kind]).
One more kind of output ('an animated post for LinkedIn'): founder on the left half, the piece generated and edited on the right (quotient-social or the editor).
'Every other AI tool makes AI slop': a grey, dim wall of generic work (asset-wall layout wall, tone 'grey'), the colour gone. The contrast is the argument: their world is grey, ours is colour.

What the team believes, in short lines ('Not a wrapper.' 'We built the canvas first.' 'We taught them taste.'): big type on white, one line at a time, a typography specimen (Aa) or the agents on the canvas between lines. The last line in a big serif.

The offer over the colourful wall (asset-wall layout wall with the headline: '1,000 brands for FREE'), then how to take it acted out (the reply typed, the sign-up button clicked) and the logo with its URL.

captions.note: small, sentence case, on a dark plate: premium, never shouting

stamps.note: the raise as a rolling number

agents.note: one colour per agent, the same colour every time it appears

work.note: orbit around the founder (range), wall behind the build (agents), grid (scale), grey (enemy), wall + headline (offer)

layers.camera: slow pushes on the screens; fixed on the founder

asks.take: the founder's lines for money, range, range_2 and offer (one recording split by lines)
asks.screens: 0 -- every screen beat is motion graphics: the product's editor mockups, the asset wall's designed sample work and the agent cursors; a real recording may replace a beat
asks.images: a backer's logo for the money beat, optional
